headline: Estée Lauder Announces New Fragrance, Glimmer, with Global Campaign Starring Hailee Steinfeld
summary: NEW YORK, July 28, 2026--Today, Estée Lauder announces the launch of Glimmer, a new prestige fragrance created for a new generation of consumers. An amber floral fragrance with a gourmand twist, Glimmer transforms the power of everyday "glimmers" - small moments of joy, hope, and connection - into a sensorial fragrance experience designed to inspire optimism, foster community, and leave a lasting impression.

headline: Jefferies Maintains Hold on Estee Lauder Cos, Raises Price Target to $88
summary: Jefferies  analyst Sydney Wagner   maintains Estee Lauder Cos (NYSE:EL) with a Hold and raises the price target from $80 to $88.
